Running the product

Open the full
navigation service.

The navigation repository contains the phone interface, Express service and shared route engine. Install Node.js 22.12 or later, then follow its README.

npm ci
npm run build
npm start

Open the local service on port 8787. Configure the backend model credentials for live Qwen workflows. This project website hosts documents, images and videos.
